milestones.goal: extract-api becomes a reusable regression workload for model/gateway changes.

milestones.name: Future - invoice.v2
milestones.goal: Expand invoice fidelity only from measured v1 limitations and real fixtures.

tasks.title: Revalidate snapshot against current main
acceptance: Record current HEAD and diff from aeacafa
Stop and rebase the plan if benchmark contracts changed

tasks.title: Merge or refresh dependency PR #119
acceptance: PR merged or a reasoned hold is recorded
Exact-head CI remains green

tasks.title: Capture baseline proving checks
acceptance: Record test count, coverage, lint, mypy, fixture validation and smoke results from the actual checkout
Do not copy stale numbers from CLAUDE.md

tasks.title: Close stale issues #86, #87 and #91
acceptance: Each issue has a concise evidence comment and is closed
No code change is bundled

tasks.title: Rewrite/split omnibus issues #74, #79, #80 and #88
acceptance: Historical completed items are closed or checked off
Each remaining issue has one coherent contract and owner

tasks.title: Create evidence-focused milestones and labels
acceptance: M5 Evidence-ready benchmark, M6 Measured v0.1, M7 Release-gate workload exist
Human-required and paid-call work is visibly labelled

tasks.title: Reconcile documentation drift
acceptance: API shapes match current code
Coverage/test numbers are measured or explicitly labelled as claims
Provider and fixture status match main
One canonical state source is introduced or proposed

tasks.title: Approve benchmark metric contract
acceptance: Choices for failure layers, null denominator, nested scoring and headline metrics are explicit

tasks.title: Implement layered scoring and null-opportunity metrics
acceptance: Infrastructure, extraction and semantic outcomes are separate
Hallucination opportunity rate uses expected-null denominator
Failed extraction does not claim absent values were missed
Document exact match and accepted-extraction rate are reported

tasks.title: Add path-level nested line-item diagnostics
acceptance: Whole-list exactness remains
Index-aligned field paths are reported without fuzzy matching
Order-sensitive contract is documented

tasks.title: Surface and aggregate failed-validation spend
acceptance: Terminal 422 includes finite nonnegative cost_usd
Harness includes successful and failed spend
Report distinguishes attempted, accepted and failed cost

tasks.title: Approve transport failure and retry policy
acceptance: Unsent, ambiguous-sent, provider and control-plane outcomes are defined
Retry count and abort threshold are defined

tasks.title: Implement transport classification
acceptance: Provably unsent errors receive bounded retry
Ambiguous sent errors are journalled and not silently retried
Infrastructure failures do not enter semantic denominators
Run abort threshold prevents publishing a degraded partial run as complete

tasks.title: Add durable run manifest, JSONL journal and resume
acceptance: Each fixture result is persisted before next call
Journal is append-only and flushed
Resume refuses changed corpus/config hashes
Final summary is derived from journal, not transient memory

tasks.title: Freeze and verify run provenance
acceptance: Manifest captures repo/build/provider/model/SDK/prompt/schema/corpus/pricing hashes
Run fails on provider/model drift
Response exposes or journal captures token and attempt metadata
Secrets and raw document content are excluded by default

tasks.title: Approve targeted job-schema tightening
acceptance: Decision on negative salaries and blank strings is recorded

tasks.title: Apply targeted job-schema invariants
acceptance: Negative salary values fail
Blank title/company/location values fail when non-null
No whitespace/value coercion is introduced

tasks.title: Import synthetic DRAFT fixture candidates
acceptance: No existing fixture is overwritten
All imported files remain DRAFT
Fixture validator passes

tasks.title: Generate corpus inventory, hashes and coverage matrix
acceptance: Every fixture has source/status/edge-case tags in a sidecar manifest
Reviewed and DRAFT counts are generated
Corpus hash is deterministic

tasks.title: Review synthetic invoice labels
acceptance: Each accepted fixture is independently checked against content
Ambiguous cases remain DRAFT or are corrected
REVIEWED flips are human-authored commits

tasks.title: Review synthetic job-posting labels
acceptance: Salary, period, seniority, remote and visa semantics are checked
Ambiguous right-to-work wording is not overclaimed

tasks.title: Source and anonymize real invoice fixtures
acceptance: Target reviewed corpus size/strata are met
No personal/company identifiers remain
Rights/provenance review is recorded

tasks.title: Source and anonymize real UK job-posting fixtures
acceptance: Roughly half of reviewed job fixtures are real-anonymized unless explicitly waived
Edge-case coverage is balanced
Source snapshots and rights notes are retained privately or as hashes

tasks.title: Build test-only fixture response map and in-process ASGI rehearsal
acceptance: Production client cannot access expected labels
Perfect corpus run traverses real endpoint/pipeline/scorer/report path
Fixture mapping is keyed by content hash or fixture ID supplied only by harness

tasks.title: Rehearse error and interruption matrix offline
acceptance: 422 cost, provider error, timeout, connect failure, budget skip, mixed provider, crash/resume and output failure are exercised

tasks.title: Create benchmark report snapshots and claim guard
acceptance: Report labels denominators and incomplete runs
README cannot replace Numbers pending without a complete approved run manifest

tasks.title: Configure and verify paid provider settings
acceptance: Model IDs are current and intentional
Input/output prices and source date are recorded
Budget is approved
Keys never enter git or logs

tasks.title: Estimate run cost before calls
acceptance: Upper-bound estimate uses corpus byte/token estimate, max output and retry policy
Run refuses zero/unknown prices unless explicitly acknowledged

tasks.title: Authorize paid pilot
acceptance: Explicit run ID, providers, models, fixtures and maximum spend are approved

tasks.title: Run small paid canary
acceptance: 2-3 representative fixtures per provider/domain complete
Provider SDK live compatibility is proven
Manifest, journal, summary and report are preserved

tasks.title: Approve full paid run after pilot
acceptance: Pilot anomalies are resolved or accepted
Full budget and corpus version are frozen

tasks.title: Run full frozen benchmark
acceptance: Every eligible fixture has a terminal journal state
No provider/model/corpus drift occurred
Incomplete infrastructure conditions prevent report promotion

tasks.title: Review outliers and label disputes
acceptance: Label errors are corrected in a new corpus version, never silently in-place under the same report
Model failures are not relabelled away without rationale

tasks.title: Generate final measured report and README tables
acceptance: Report includes corpus/provider/model/provenance, denominators, confidence intervals/caveats, cost and latency
Numbers are generated from journal
No unmeasured capability language replaces evidence

tasks.title: Approve public claims and release boundary
acceptance: Claims match measured domains and corpus
Known schema limitations are disclosed
License posture is accepted

tasks.title: Publish v0.1.0 release artifact
acceptance: A signed/verified tag or release is created
Report and manifest are attached or linked
No secrets/raw private fixtures are shipped

tasks.title: Create release-gate baseline and comparator
acceptance: Baseline promotion is explicit
Relative quality/cost/latency regressions fail with useful diagnostics
No absolute threshold is invented before data

tasks.title: Approve baseline promotion and paid cadence
acceptance: Baseline SHA/run ID and cadence budget are explicit

tasks.title: Prove agent-harness wiring and pin floor provenance
acceptance: Actual PreToolUse route is documented
Digest check is fast and required
Full matrix is path-filtered/scheduled
No autonomous weakening of guard semantics occurs

tasks.title: Retire duplicate hook and normalization dead code
acceptance: Each module is either wired to a named product workflow or removed
Coverage remains meaningful rather than preserved for dead code

tasks.title: Harden gateway-only deployment and observability
acceptance: No direct public exposure in documented deployment
Request/run IDs and structured redacted logs exist
Container has resource/security options appropriate to untrusted PDFs
Docker build is a required gate

tasks.title: Create trigger-gated future epics
acceptance: Invoice.v2, concurrent idempotency, auth taxonomy and ISO maintenance have explicit activation triggers
